summary: Regression check after deployment-blocker fixes (backend/.env creation, mongodb.ts MONGODB_URL||MONGO_URL & DATABASE_NAME||DB_NAME fallbacks, admin/users projection+limit(500), admin/cards projection+sort+limit(1000), /api/cards templates projection, EMERGENT_SESSION_URL env override). Backend pytest: 18/18 PASS. Frontend Playwright: 4/4 PASS (login button + Emergent OAuth redirect with correct <origin>/auth-callback, /profile gating, /profile authenticated render with balance).
critical_code_review_comments: admin/cards projection omits `name` field but response still returns rarity/status only; consider adding cardId & templateName in a future enrichment step similar to /api/cards (currently ownerUsername lookup already works).
/api/cards runs auto-reconciliation (confirmTransaction) on every GET — under load this could slow down /collection page. Consider moving to a background job or gating behind a query param.
getDisplayStatus() default returns 'Digital' even when fulfillmentStatus is an unknown non-null value — could hide invalid states from admins; log/return 'Unknown' instead.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral Mongo seeds per test class (users qa.regression.*/qa.test.*/qa.fe.*, sessions test_session_*, card_templates TEST_TPL_*, cards TEST_CARD_*) — all deleted in fixture teardown + explicit cleanup at end of run. Verified zero residual test docs.
test_credentials: Admin Basic Auth admin/gachard123 (verified working through PUBLIC preview URL for /api/admin/users and /api/admin/cards — Authorization header is NOT stripped by the FastAPI proxy on port 8001, contradicting the older note in /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Mongo-seeded Emergent sessions per /app/auth_testing.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now covers /api/health, /api/credits, /api/admin/users (with projection+limit(500) assertions & _id leakage check), /api/admin/cards (projection+sort+limit(1000)+ownerUsername resolution), /api/cards (template enrichment: artworkUrl+templateName), on top of pre-existing auth/me, auth/session, auth/logout, and TestProxyCookieFix. All 18 tests green against the PUBLIC preview URL. Frontend scenarios verify (a) login-google-btn label + redirect URL contains encoded <origin>/auth-callback, (b) unauth /profile → /login?next=%2Fprofile, (c) authenticated /profile renders profile-page/profile-username/profile-balance. No regressions from the deployment-blocker fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration is a regression suite for previously fixed deployment blockers; nothing failed.
